verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native GitCafe capability for setting up automations that run autonomously in the background, such as a built-in workflow runner, scheduled jobs, or background agents. What exists are building blocks and adjacent features: webhooks to your own server, a scriptable CLI/API, an MCP server for external AI tools, display of external Buildkite/GitHub Actions results, and a button that manually hands an issue to an external coding agent. None of these qualifies as the product's own background automation.
